notes: Dev-only grey box (mw-e22.9), not shipped: the greybox villager's chat, to try walking up to someone and talking in a debug build (?scene=conversation-room&debug=1). Enter or E continues a line; 1 to 9 picks an option; the purse option is locked until you carry 99 gold, to show a locked reason (mw-e22.10). The real conversations are written under E39.
